_doc: Certification ledger (tier-4 §7). Append-only. Fields: asset, criterion, criterion_version, detector, evidence (path/query/run id), verdict (PASS|FAIL|PARTIAL|NO_DETECTOR|N/A), verified_by, verified_on. ELEVATED requires a current PASS or N/A on every required criterion AND zero open rows of kind=gap in asset_gaps.jsonl (open opportunities never block). verified_by records who ran the detector; the independence that matters is the detector's — it must be able to fail — not the runner's identity (native ruling 9, 2026-09-25: one operator runs this system). A record without a run id or query in `evidence` is not a record.
